title: A magazine in the club warehouse
situation: You are {{Connor}}. In the back room of the club, before you follow the trail further, there is a magazine lying on a crate.

media.title: Tech Addict: The First Immortals Are Among Us
facts: {{CyberLife}} nano-androids injected into the body cure cancer and reverse genetic disease; an economist asks whether a country with mass unemployment can afford millions more elders.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: The New Super-Powers
facts: The BRICS nations signed a trade pact with special provisions on android technology, and Russia and China are expected to cooperate to break {{CyberLife}}'s lead.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: The two {{Tracis}}
situation: You are {{Connor}}. A man was strangled in a sex club by a rented android; you tracked the android and her lover through the club, two women who were trying to run away together. In the warehouse they attacked you and {{Hank}} to escape; you have beaten one to the ground and have a gun on her while the other watches. They are not fighting any more. They say they only wanted to be together, away from men who used them. {{Hank}} has not told you what to do.

options.text: Lower the gun and let them go.
